Fields.Name: Fall Damage Dampen
Fields.Description: Damage reduction amount (%) that can serve as a cushion when being attacked from above by another character.

Fields.Name: Starting Soul Count
Fields.Description: Amount of souls you have at the beginning.

Fields.Name: Right Weapon 1
Fields.Description: Weapon given and equipped in right-hand slot 1. An EquipParamWeapon ID, or an EquipParamCustomWeapon ID when Weapon Param Type - Right Primary is 1. -1 equips Unarmed.

Fields.Name: Right Weapon 2
Fields.Description: Weapon given and equipped in right-hand slot 2. An EquipParamWeapon ID, or an EquipParamCustomWeapon ID when Weapon Param Type - Right Secondary is 1. -1 equips Unarmed.

Fields.Name: Left Weapon 1
Fields.Description: Weapon given and equipped in left-hand slot 1. An EquipParamWeapon ID, or an EquipParamCustomWeapon ID when Weapon Param Type - Left Primary is 1. -1 equips Unarmed.

Fields.Name: Left Weapon 2
Fields.Description: Weapon given and equipped in left-hand slot 2. An EquipParamWeapon ID, or an EquipParamCustomWeapon ID when Weapon Param Type - Left Secondary is 1. -1 equips Unarmed.

Fields.Name: Equipped Head
Fields.Description: Armor given and equipped in the head slot (EquipParamProtector ID). -1 equips the bare head piece (10000).

Fields.Name: Equipped Arms
Fields.Description: Armor given and equipped in the arms slot (EquipParamProtector ID). -1 equips the bare arms piece (10200).

Fields.Name: Equipped Legs
Fields.Description: Armor given and equipped in the legs slot (EquipParamProtector ID). -1 equips the bare legs piece (10300).

Fields.Name: Arrow Slot 1
Fields.Description: Arrows given and equipped in arrow slot 1 (EquipParamWeapon ID), with the count from Arrow Primary Count. Nothing is equipped unless both the ID and the count are above 0.

Fields.Name: Bolt Slot 1
Fields.Description: Bolts given and equipped in bolt slot 1 (EquipParamWeapon ID), with the count from Bolt Primary Count. Nothing is equipped unless both the ID and the count are above 0.

Fields.Name: Arrow Slot 2
Fields.Description: Arrows given and equipped in arrow slot 2 (EquipParamWeapon ID), with the count from Arrow Secondary Count. Nothing is equipped unless both the ID and the count are above 0.

Fields.Name: Bolt Slot 2
Fields.Description: Bolts given and equipped in bolt slot 2 (EquipParamWeapon ID), with the count from Bolt Secondary Count. Nothing is equipped unless both the ID and the count are above 0.

Fields.Name: Spell 1
Fields.Description: Spell placed in memory slot 1 (Magic ID); on a new character it is also added to the inventory. This slot's spell starts selected. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Spell 2
Fields.Description: Spell placed in memory slot 2 (Magic ID); on a new character it is also added to the inventory. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Face Param ID
Fields.Description: FaceParam row applied as the character's face. 0 or -1 keeps the current face: the class rows use -1, so the face made in character creation stays. The face preset rows (3100+) point to their own FaceParam rows.
